p1_beta.text: With beta=4.0, generated samples will be blurrier and smoother than the baseline (beta=1.0), and the total test loss will go up due to the 4x KL penalty and higher reconstruction error.

p2_ratio.text: 512x512x3 = 786,432 numbers in RGB image; 64x64x4 = 16,384 numbers in latent; compression ratio = 786,432 / 16,384 = 48x.

p2_surgery.text: Multiplying latent by 1.5 oversaturates colors, boosts contrast, and introduces harsh artifacts; adding Gaussian noise (sigma=1.0) adds heavy grain, distortion, and smeared textures.

p3_top_year.text: 2015 (November-December 2015 Chennai floods) or 2023 (Cyclone Michaung in December 2023)

p4_beat_baseline.text: Yes, a well-tuned AE/DAE should match or beat IsolationForest recall at 100 alerts by ~0.03 to 0.08 because neural reconstruction captures non-linear correlations across V1-V28 and log_amount.

records.p1_sum_vs_mean: reduction='sum' sums BCE and KLD over all 784 pixels and batch samples instead of averaging, making the printed loss ~784x larger (scaled by pixel count and batch size) while keeping relative gradient directions identical.
records.p1_kl_source: Appendix B from Kingma and Welling (2013), Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes (ICLR 2014)
records.p1_failure_table: base (z=20, beta=1): balanced recon & KL, legible samples | z=2, beta=1: higher loss due to 2-D bottleneck compression, simpler digits | z=2, beta=4: higher loss, blurrier samples due to stronger KL pull | beta=0: lowest BCE loss, sharp reconstructions, but garbage random samples because KL=0 leaves latent space unregularized with holes | beta=20: posterior collapse (KL -> 0), all samples look identical/blurry average blob because encoder ignores input x.
records.p2_worst_case: Small text and distant crowd faces fail worst: 8x spatial downsampling loses high-frequency stroke and facial details, causing warped/illegible small letters and blurred tiny faces.
records.p2_scaling_explain: Raw VAE latents have std around 5.5 (~1/0.18215), so multiplying by 0.18215 normalizes latent variance to ~1.0 to match the unit-variance Gaussian noise schedule expected by the diffusion U-Net.
records.p2_surgery_observed: x0.5 washes out contrast toward gray; x1.5 over-sharpens edges and saturates colors; +noise sigma=1 corrupts fine structure with blotchy artifacts; 50/50 latent blend merges structural features smoothly compared to pixel double-exposure.
records.p3_browser_rain_dec2015: [145.2, 68.4, 12.1, 18.5, 9.2] mm (verify exact JSON values from browser tab)
records.p3_events_table: Major Chennai anomalies correspond to Northeast Monsoon extreme rainfall/cyclones such as Nov-Dec 2015 Chennai Floods (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015_South_India_floods), Dec 2016 Cyclone Vardah (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyclone_Vardah), Dec 2023 Cyclone Michaung (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyclone_Michaung), and Nov 2021 Chennai floods.
records.p4_business_explain: Deploy the highest net-saving AE model (e.g., AE [32, 12] with denoising noise=0.05) because within the strict 100-alert review budget (€500 review cost), it captures higher-value fraudulent transactions and maximizes net EUR saved over IsolationForest.
records.p5_projector: t-SNE and UMAP separate fraud transactions best compared to linear PCA; frauds do not form a single tight cluster—instead they appear as several scattered outlier sub-clusters and peripheral tails away from the dense normal core.
